guidance: Encrypt all data in transit, ideally as a blanket practice. Configure load balancer listeners to use HTTPS/TLS and use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to automatically provision, renew, and rotate TLS certificates on ALBs — eliminating expired certificate risk. Public ACM certificates are free. For internal applications, deploy ACM Private CA for automated certificate rotation.
how_to_check: Is encryption in transit enforced across all services transmitting sensitive data? Are load balancer listeners configured for HTTPS/TLS only? Are TLS certificates managed via ACM with automatic renewal? Are internal applications using ACM Private CA? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
